changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 5 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/4795-bindable-text-keys.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > Published authoring guidance updated to match: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` (new "Bindable Text Keys" rule), plus the `page-builder`, `schema-expressions` and `data-integration` guides, which taught the now-retired "never evaluated" statement and its host-pre-resolution workaround.

### `.changeset/5942-retire-mobile-component-config.md`

- names `skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md` → `skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md` — edited by this change

  > Removed outright rather than kept as a `?: never` tombstone, on this package's own retire-vs-remove discriminator, in the form objectui#7678 amended it to. That rule is cited here and not restated: it is stated once, and a second copy carried in a release note could only drift out of agreement with it. Measured against it the route is removal — the whole interface goes, so there is no surviving object to hang a `never` key on, and no documentation ever described it (`skills/objectui/guides/mobile.md` teaches the hooks, never this type). Same zero-pull, no-successor shape as `MobileOverrides` (objectui#4919) and `AccordionItem.icon` / `ToggleGroupItem.icon`.

### `.changeset/6357-basechema-bind-declaration.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > `bind` was read by ten production sites and declared by no schema shape. It resolved as `any` through `BaseSchema`'s index signature and rode `.passthrough()` on the validator, while three separate documents taught it as an authorable key of *every* node: this repo's own `AGENTS.md` §4 ("Every node in the UI tree follows this shape (`@object-ui/types`)"), the published agent-facing `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` ("Every UI component node MUST follow this shape"), and `content/docs/fields/grid.mdx`. So the agent-facing protocol told authors to write a key the published types did not know existed.

### `.changeset/6575-data-table-bind-diagnostic.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > The platform was already paying for this in teaching rather than in diagnostics: `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` documents the pothole verbatim and a pin test locks the behaviour. The warning now also reaches the console, where the author who did not read the docs is standing:

### `.changeset/6665-data-table-non-array-data-diagnostic.md`

- names `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` → `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` — edited by this change

  > The spelling that opened the card is a `${...}` expression string, and it is a defect rather than a design because the SAME expression is evaluated one key over. Re-measured on merge-base `5967be095` through the real `SchemaRenderer` (the table was previously quoted from `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` as a measurement on `f1c27f037` and had not been re-run); all four legs reproduced, and they are now pinned as tests rather than prose:

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `f9d772b16` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1540 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2126 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36187892215)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ae9ef099d5cce7c679f94357664a81a4394d4120`

### ① Derived judgments

1. **How the catalog is consumed, and why "installs from main" is the defect, not the defence.** The skill ships by `npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectui` (README, `content/docs/guide/agent-skills.md`, `skills/objectui/README.md`): the `skills` CLI fetches the GitHub repo at its default branch. No npm tarball, no release tag, no version field that moves (`SKILL.md` `metadata.version: "2.0"` was set once, in #7370). So the paragraph goes live for every reader at squash time, while the reader's `@object-ui/components` comes from npm at 17.6.0 (published 2026-08-24; #8435 merged 2026-09-07; `.changeset/7097-grid-2xl-breakpoint.md` is still pending on main). Measured on the 17.6.0 tarball: 0 dist files contain `2xl:grid-cols`, no `columns['2xl']` read arm; `{xs:1,"2xl":6}` renders `grid grid-cols-1 gap-4`. A reader who follows "the `grid` renderer reads all six" today gets exactly the silent drop the old paragraph existed to prevent. The body's "the paragraph describes the code it will ship with" is wrong in its premise: the catalog does not ship with a release, it is served from main now. The paragraph needs a release-neutral qualifier and must keep the fallback advice for pre-#7097 installs. Replacement text in the verdict (issue-anchored, no version literal: objectui#8924's lesson is that nothing reads a version literal in prose).

2. **Attribution is correct on the package and misleading on the symbol.** `BreakpointColumnMap` is declared in `packages/layout/src/ResponsiveGrid.tsx` on main and re-exported by `@object-ui/layout`'s index; `@object-ui/types` exports it nowhere (0 export lines on main, 0 d.ts files in 17.6.0; control 7 d.ts files name `GridSchema`). The triage's "(`@object-ui/types`)" was wrong and the dev fixed it correctly. In 17.6.0 `@object-ui/layout`'s d.ts only re-exports the name from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (pre-existing, see ③). But `grid`'s own `columns` is `Partial` of `Record` over `BreakpointName` (`packages/types/src/layout.ts`, `BreakpointName` in `mobile.ts`, zod mirror `z.partialRecord` over the six names), and `grid` never imports `BreakpointColumnMap`, which the card itself states. Telling a `grid` author the six keys are "declared as `BreakpointColumnMap` in `@object-ui/layout`" sends them to `responsive-grid`'s type, not to the one that types `grid.columns`: the objectstack#4115 shape the card was filed to remove. True as a statement about the vocabulary, wrong as a pointer. The replacement names `BreakpointName` / `GridSchema.columns` first and `BreakpointColumnMap` as the same six.

3. **The fence deviation was right in direction and incomplete in execution.** On main `grid.tsx` has `GRID_COLS_2XL` and the `columns['2xl']` arm; I ran `grid-breakpoint-columns-7097.test.tsx` on current main `383a34f52` in a scratch worktree: 1 file, 11 of 11 passed (worktree removed). The claim comment conditioned keeping the sentence on re-measurement, so leaving "accepted and then dropped" would have been the worse defect. The deviation is declared in the body. Two things in the same published bundle were left contradicting the new paragraph:
   - The intro sentence of the same Rule still reads "keyed `xs` / `sm` / `md` / `lg` / `xl`". Before the PR that matched "reads only the first five"; now it contradicts "reads all six" two paragraphs later. "Incomplete but not wrong" does not hold once the section itself says six.
   - `skills/objectui/evals/protocol.json` id 3 (authored with this paragraph in #7370) still grades the correct answer as "2xl parses but the grid renderer reads only xs through xl, so a 2xl entry emits no class. Rewrites it as columns on the node, stopping at xl, and offers className". The bundle's own grader now fails an agent that has read the bundle's own rule. `check-skill-eval-tokens` states it does not judge `expected_output`, so Skill Eval Token Check is green on a self-contradiction. The eval must move with the rule, in this PR.

4. **Gates and changeset.** Reaching `skills/**`: `check:skills-paths` (Skill Guide Path Check), `check:skill-eval-tokens` (Skill Eval Token Check), `check-shell-escape-residue` (Shell Escape Residue Scan) and Skill Example Check (`skill-examples.yml`, deliberately no path filter, builds dist and compiles marked fences). All four concluded success on the head. The dev's "cannot move it" argument holds: the hunk has no fence or marker line; protocol.md has 26 fence-delimiter lines (13 fences) and 12 markers on both base and head; 88 markers under `skills/` on both. `check-changeset-presence` guards `pkg/src/**` of the `fixed` group only; `skills/` is not a workspace package (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`: packages, examples, apps, docs) and has no versioning of its own, so "no changeset owed" is right. No line ratchet exists on `skills/**` (the ratchets in `check-skill-examples.mjs` are marked-fence floors; `check-skills-paths` ratchets its exemption baseline); the card's and triage's "line ratchet" names no gate on this tree, the body's statement holds.

5. **PR body, sentence by sentence.** Line 1 `Fixes #7599` is the only closing keyword. No tag-shaped angle brackets (the one `>` is the arrow in "report-only -> exit 0"). No model identifier. Verified true: base `1e946c96a` is the merge-base; 361 → 359 lines, 15992 → 15881 bytes; SKILL.md 137 both; spec 17.4.0 in the lockfile, 0 dist files with `BreakpointColumnMapSchema` and 56 with `FieldSchema`; flat inputs stop at `xlColumns`; `{xs:1, xl:5}` row verbatim; main has not touched protocol.md, grid.tsx, ResponsiveGrid.tsx or `packages/types/src` since base. Not reproduced, immaterial: "17 test files" (I count 15 by `git grep -l` over test globs), "3 export lines name `BreakpointName`" (I count 2 plus the `export type` block in index.ts). Wrong conclusion: the "Release timing" bullet (judgment 1). Per template, not defects: empty "席位意见" and "(草稿)" (os-dev role file: seat opinion left blank), session-URL footer. objectui#7097 is not retrievable via REST (404, as is #7096); the cite is corroborated by PR #8435 ("Fixes #7097", merged `3cab5703b`, grid.tsx +33, the pin test, the 7097 changeset on main).

6. **CI and merge.** 39 check runs on the head: 36 success, 3 skipped (coverage matrix, dependabot), 0 failed, none pending; combined status success. Governed Surface Queue Guard success is the report-only `pull_request` leg (exit 0 by design). `git merge-tree --write-tree` against current `origin/main` `383a34f52`: exit 0, clean.

### ② Semver level

None. Prose only on `skills/**`; no package source, no published contract, no changeset owed and none present; the catalog carries no version.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed surface `skills-catalog` (`skills/**`): stays draft until a latest-decisive APPROVED review from a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`). This record is not that approval, and a PASS here would not replace it. It is also a dispatched PR (Claim comment), so the dispatch seat lands it after approval, not the dev.
- Deviation from `5549222679` boundary 1 (attribution only): declared, right in direction, and the reason the eval and intro fixes are now owed inside the same file surface (`skills/objectui/`, same governed approval).
- Triage `5818990275` mis-attributed the owner package (`@object-ui/types`); the dev's `@object-ui/layout` is the measured owner.
- Release-window exposure: the catalog is served from main; the installed base is 17.6.0 where `grid` drops `2xl`.
- Pre-existing, out of scope: `@object-ui/layout@17.6.0`'s d.ts re-exports `BreakpointColumnMap` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` while depending on `^17.0.0`, which resolves to 17.3.0 or later where that export is gone. The pending 7580 changeset is the fix; worth a card if none exists.
- Pin run: the locked attempt hit queue-timeout (exit 99, NOT MEASURED) behind another seat's full `packages/components/` run; the lock ledger shows the dev's own locked run of the same file with rc=0. I ran the single file unlocked (not a heavy verification under the AGENTS.md lock rule): 11 of 11. Scratch worktree removed.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-7599-breakpoint-attribution`
Reviewed-by: `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Wording only; three replacements, all inside `skills/objectui/`.

1. `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`, intro sentence of "Rule: Layout Responsiveness", replace the key list:
   breakpoint object keyed `xs` / `sm` / `md` / `lg` / `xl` / `2xl` (`GridSchema` in `packages/types/src/layout.ts`):

2. `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`, the rewritten paragraph, replace whole:
   **`2xl` is the sixth key.** Six keys — `xs` … `xl` **plus `2xl`** — are objectui's own breakpoint vocabulary: `BreakpointName` in `@object-ui/types` is the key set of `GridSchema.columns`, and `BreakpointColumnMap` in `@object-ui/layout` (`responsive-grid`) spells the same six. Since objectui#7097 the `grid` renderer reads all six. Measured on main: `{xs:1, xl:5}` → `grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4`; `{xs:1, "2xl":6}` → `grid grid-cols-1 2xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4`. On an `@object-ui/components` release that predates objectui#7097 the `2xl` step is accepted and silently dropped (`grid grid-cols-1 gap-4`): there, stop at `xl` or carry the widest step in `className`.

3. `skills/objectui/evals/protocol.json`, eval id 3, replace `expected_output` (keep `must_contain` `columns`, `node`, `xl`, `className`; all still taught):
   Names the two faults that cause the flat grid: the keys are under props and so are never read; the key is columns, not cols, which no schema or renderer declares. Rewrites it as columns on the node with xs, md and 2xl. Notes that 2xl is the sixth breakpoint key and is read by the grid renderer since objectui#7097; on an earlier @object-ui/components release the 2xl step is accepted and silently dropped, so there stop at xl or carry the widest step in className.

Neither replacement adds a fence, a marker, a path, a path:line citation or a version literal, so the four `skills/**` gates and the line-citation gate are not moved.
